skills/engineering/ask-matt.note: Second router. mattpo-mode is the manager, so this skill is not registered.

skills/engineering/domain-modeling.note: Upstream edits GLOSSARY.md and ADRs inline. Write those files when the user asks you to update them. Until then, show the hunk.

skills/engineering/grill-with-docs.note: Upstream edits the glossary and ADRs as the interview goes. Write those files when the user asks. Ask one question, then wait.

skills/engineering/implement.note: Upstream says to commit. Leave the work in the working tree until the user asks you to commit.

skills/engineering/implement-spec.note: Upstream creates worktrees, merges, opens a pull request, and deletes worktrees. Implement in the current tree until the user asks for those git actions.

skills/engineering/improve-codebase-arch.note: Deliver the hotspot report and stop for a choice. Do not apply a refactor, and do not schedule a recurring pass, unless the user asks for that change.

skills/engineering/pr.note: Write the pull request body in the reply. Open the pull request only when the user asks.

skills/engineering/prototype.note: Keep a throwaway prototype in a scratch directory the user accepts. Commit it only when the user asks.

skills/engineering/research.note: Put the cited notes in the reply, or in a path the user named.

skills/engineering/retro.note: Propose one environment change. Do not edit agent config unless the user asks for that edit.

skills/engineering/setup-matt-pocock-ski.note: Upstream writes tracker docs and can create labels. Show the draft and write it when the user asks. Do not run this because the plugin was installed.

skills/engineering/to-spec.note: Upstream publishes the spec to the issue tracker. Write the spec in the reply, or in a file the user named, until they ask you to publish.

skills/engineering/to-tickets.note: Upstream publishes tickets. Write the vertical slices locally until the user asks you to publish them.

skills/engineering/triage.note: Upstream changes tracker labels and can close items. Confirm the tracker write before you do it.

skills/engineering/wayfinder.note: Upstream stores the decision map on the issue tracker. Draft the map locally until the user asks you to publish it.

skills/engineering/wizard.note: Show the wizard script. Do not run it.

skills/productivity/grilling.note: Upstream continues until every branch of the design tree is empty. Ask the single highest-impact question, then wait.

skills/productivity/to-questionnaire.note: Draft the questionnaire. Do not send it.

skills/productivity/writing-for-agents.note: Edit a steering file only when the user asked you to change that file.
